# pve_apt_changelog (Data Source)

Changelog of one package version on a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_apt_changelog" "example" {
  name = "CHANGE_ME"
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Package name.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `version` (String) Package version.

### Read-Only

- `changelog` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
